journey.title: Re-expose an expired route
journey.purpose: Recover an expired exposure without losing its route identity or safety disclosures.

steps.intent: Filter or inspect the expired lease collection.
Open the route detail and select re-expose.
Review the new duration, target, hostname, and publicness boundary.
Confirm and verify the new lease result.

claims.statement: Re-exposure reuses the known route identity while requiring a fresh duration and review.
